passiveBonuses.desc: Prelate priests can inspire nearby villagers, increasing their gather rate by 40% for 30 seconds. Each Prelate can inspire one villager at a time. Multiple Prelates can be assigned to the same resource cluster
HRE starts with one free Prelate unit in addition to standard starting units, giving an immediate economic efficiency advantage
Relics stored in Regnitz Cathedral generate triple the standard gold income (3 gold/s per relic vs 1 gold/s). Encourages aggressive relic collection in early game
All HRE walls, towers, and keeps have +20% HP and garrison capacity. Towers can be upgraded to emit an aura that inspires nearby infantry with +10% attack speed

age2.bonus: All military technologies cost 25% less to research. Acts as a secondary technology building that can research Feudal Age upgrades simultaneously with the Blacksmith
Villagers are created 100% faster and do not require food to train — they cost only wood. Represents the HRE's serfs and bound labor system

age3.bonus: Can produce batches of 5 military units (Men-at-Arms, Spearmen, or Horsemen) simultaneously at significantly reduced cost per unit. Essentially functions as 3 barracks in one building
All Keeps and Outposts gain +100% HP and emit an Influence aura that reduces damage taken by nearby units by 15%. Transforms defensive towers into battlefield anchors

age4.bonus: All military units trained anywhere on the map gain +15% HP and +10% attack permanently. Functions as a central command that reinforces all armies globally
Can hold up to 5 relics (standard maximum is 3). Each relic inside generates 4 gold/s and emits a Divine Blessing aura that heals nearby units for 5 HP/s

uniqueUnits.special: Support priest unit that can inspire villagers for +40% gather rate and inspire military units for +10% attack. Can collect and carry relics. Heals friendly units at 10 HP/s in combat range

Two-handed swordsman with a whirlwind AoE attack that damages all enemies within melee range simultaneously. Extremely effective against massed infantry formations. Takes bonus damage from ranged units due to light armor
HRE Men-at-Arms are heavier armored than standard equivalents, gaining +15% bonus defense against ranged attacks. Can be further upgraded via unique HRE Blacksmith technologies
Armored wagon with a ranged crossbow attack. Can garrison 2 infantry inside who fire additional projectiles. Counts as both cavalry and siege for upgrade purposes

uniqueTech.effect: Prelates can now inspire military units in addition to villagers, granting +10% attack speed and +5% HP to any unit they bless. Each inspired buff lasts 60 seconds
All HRE cavalry gain +30 HP and projectile damage reduction of 20%. Represents the heavy plate armor tradition of Holy Roman knights
All infantry units gain +15% movement speed outside of combat, allowing rapid repositioning of the HRE's infantry-heavy armies across the battlefield
All buildings within the HRE city center (12-tile radius of Town Center) generate +0.5 gold per second. Encourages compact, fortified city building
